map.name: Manhunt
map.testedVersion: Static source/package audit with native LevelDB voxel proof; runtime not executed

bugs.title: Arena 6 is materially incomplete compared with the authored replica
bugs.problem: Arena 6 is presented as a normal playable Manhunt arena but contains a substantial missing-geometry region compared with the canonical translated arena.
bugs.expected: Arena 6 contains the same gameplay world structure as the canonical arena after the authored translation, aside from bounded intentional differences.
bugs.observed: Native voxel proof finds about 5.62% sampled mismatches in Arena 6, concentrated where thousands of canonical structure blocks are missing as air.
reproduction: Enter or inspect Manhunt Arena 1 and Arena 6.
Compare the corresponding far-side arena region using the authored Arena 6 translation.
Move through the area corresponding roughly to the canonical Z -340 through -220 region.
Confirm substantial geometry present in the canonical arena is missing in Arena 6.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Selected source config authors Arena 6 as the sixth translated replica, but native LevelDB voxel comparison shows 6,207 sampled mismatches, dominated by canonical stone/wool/tuff/concrete blocks becoming air. Other replicas remain near-zero mismatch.

relevantCode.reason: Defines Arena 6 as a normal playable translated replica with the same gameplay contract.
Shows the concentrated Arena 6 geometry deficit relative to the canonical translated arena.

bugs.suggestedFix: Restore Arena 6 from the canonical arena using the authored translation, then rerun voxel and block-entity replica proof before release.
mustPreserve: Arena 6 join/session identity must remain distinct while only divergent world content is restored.
